name: pipeline-stop-loss
description: Stop-loss attached to an entry: a filled market BUY carrying setStopPrice(90) automatically places a pending STOP-SELL into the pending-order queue; the sell amount comes from the pipeline's own position state at trigger time, not from anything stored on the pending order. Funding 1000, zero fees. Tick script: t1 last=100 -> BuySignal market with setStopPrice(90) fills 10 base @100 (zero fee), stop-sell@90 auto-enqueued; t2 last=95 -> resolved before the strategy sees t2, no trigger (95 > 90); t3 last=89 -> triggers (89 <= 90), fills AT 90 -> output 900, input 1000, pnl -100, final equity 900. Pins the stop-loss attachment end to end.

ticks.action: strategy emits BuySignal orderKind=market with setStopPrice(90)
resolves pending stop-sell: 89<=90, fires, fills AT 90
